name: lanes
description: Run several Claude sessions in tmux: a lead plans, lanes build, a journal carries state, lanes are cleared at a context threshold and resume.

plugins.name: lanes-jobs
plugins.description: Tmux pane pool with STATUS files and slot locks (lanes-job).

plugins.name: lanes-review
plugins.description: Adversarial reviewer agent, instructed not to edit; not sandboxed.

plugins.name: lanes-guards
plugins.description: Multi-session guards: only the lead runs CI, merges and default-branch pushes; only the lead sends plans; no edits in the main checkout. Requires the core lanes plugin.

plugins.name: lanes-prodfence
plugins.description: Production fence: refuses any tool call that mentions a configured production marker (lanes-prodfence).
